name: reuse-custom-control-workspace
description: Workspace of @abap2ui5/reuse-custom-control: the npm package (packages/) and an example app that uses it (examples/)

scripts.start: npm run sync && npm run start --workspace examples/host-app
scripts.build: npm run sync && npm run build --workspace examples/host-app
scripts.pack:check: npm run sync && npm pack --dry-run --workspace packages/reuse-custom-control
